Name: Extra
Description: Enables supersampling for higher quality, smoother lighting edges.

Name: Bounce
Description: Maximum number of radiosity light bounces (default 8).

Name: Chop
Description: Radiosity patch size for normal (non-texlight) faces. Lower values increase quality at the cost of speed/memory.

Name: Texchop
Description: Radiosity patch size for texlight-emitting faces.

Name: Smooth
Description: Smoothing threshold angle (degrees) for shared normals between adjacent faces.

Name: Ambient
Description: Minimum ambient world light applied to every face, as R G B (0.0-1.0 each).
Warning: Pass as three space-separated values, e.g. 0.1 0.1 0.1

Name: Blur
Description: Blurs the lightmap to soften GoldSrc's blocky shadow edges (default 1.5). Use 1.0 for the classic look.

Name: Max Light
Description: Caps the maximum light level, preventing fully overbright surfaces.

Name: Circus
Description: Debug mode: sets unlit direct-lighting pixels to a random fullbright color to help locate unlit lightmaps.
Warning: Debugging aid, not for final compiles.

Name: Sparse
Description: Reduces memory use of the sparse light-patch matrix at some cost to speed.

Name: Chart
Description: Prints BSP statistics before writing the output.

Name: Texdata
Description: Increases the texture memory pool size, in KB.

Name: Low Priority
Description: Runs HLRAD as a low-priority process.

Name: High Priority
Description: Runs HLRAD as a high-priority process.
Warning: Can freeze your computer while compiling.

Name: Threads
Description: Manually overrides the number of CPU threads used.
